Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Our demand for this part is fixed and committed to you for the contract term, with the binding volume figure immediately below. We value our relationship and hope the long contract term offers planning security, especially as our forecast for this part is rising. Would this commitment work for you?

We confirm a binding volume of 30000 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our forecast for part:360010 within this bundle is up 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 88.6% in 2026Q3 (sc:70610@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.72 per unit, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 30000 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We truly appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract and the binding volume of 30,000 units per year. 

Taking into account your forecast and our delivery performance, we can offer a revised price of €5.54 per unit. This offer accommodates your request for 45-day payment terms while reflecting the extended contract duration. To summarize, our Angebot includes a price of €5.54 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

In response to your movement, we are prepared to adjust our price to €5.42 per unit, maintaining the 45-day payment and 36-month contract terms.

Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. In response to your movement, we are prepared to reduce our price further to EUR 5.35 per unit. This offer maintains the 45-day payment terms and 36-month contract duration, representing a significant step toward your target while reflecting the value of this long-term arrangement. 

Please note that our price of €5.35 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 45 days net and a contract term of 36 months, follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Please also be aware that this proposal stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
